title: claude-code fetch_organization_members
description: One organization member from GET /v1/organizations/users, stored verbatim as the vendor sent it. Only id is checked by the connector; the other properties are typed from the vendor's documentation.

id.description: Anthropic user id. Half of the ExternalID.

role.description: The member's role, such as admin, user or claude_code_user. The only licence signal the connector emits (vendor-documented).
